# A path parameter whose name starts with sse is a path value like any other:
# only a name that is not in scope is read as an sse callback.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- templates.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))
-- index.gohtml --
{{define "GET /items/{sseID} Item(sseID)"}}{{with .Err}}failed: {{.}}{{else}}item {{.Result}}{{end}}{{end}}
-- server.go --
package server

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Item(id int) int { return id }
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	for _, tt := range []struct {
		target   string
		wantCode int
		wantBody string
	}{
		{"/items/5", http.StatusOK, "item 5"},
		{"/items/five", http.StatusBadRequest, "failed: "},
	} {
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, tt.target, nil))
		if rec.Code != tt.wantCode || !strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), tt.wantBody) {
			t.Errorf("GET %s = %d %q, want %d containing %q", tt.target, rec.Code, rec.Body.String(), tt.wantCode, tt.wantBody)
		}
	}
}
